reviews.author: Stacey Rogers Real Estate Group
reviews.body: Great Training on AI Visibility for Realtors Our team at the Stacey Rogers Real Estate Group in Lubbock, Texas recently completed the AI Visibility training with Cory Long, and it was incredibly valuable. The course helped us understand how search is evolving beyond traditional SEO and how AI platforms interpret businesses based on their online presence. One of the biggest takeaways was learning how to clearly communicate our market, services, and expertise so AI tools can accurately connect us with people looking for real estate help in Lubbock and West Texas. What stood out most was how practical the training was. We walked away with specific strategies we can immediately implement across our website and online profiles. Highly recommend this training for any real estate professionals or local businesses wanting to stay ahead of how people will discover businesses in the AI-driven search landscape.

reviews.author: Madison O'Neil
reviews.body: I'm the Director of Operations for the Stacey Rogers Real Estate Group at Keller Williams Realty in Lubbock, Texas, and we recently had the opportunity to take an AI Visibility course with Cory Long. What I learned most from the training is how quickly search is evolving from traditional SEO to AI-driven discovery. As a real estate team serving the Lubbock and West Texas market, it was eye-opening to see how important it is for businesses to clearly communicate who they are, where they operate, and what they specialize in so AI tools can accurately recommend them. What stood out to me most was how practical and actionable the course was. Cory showed us specific ways to strengthen our online presence: things like improving how our business is described across platforms, making sure our expertise and service areas are clearly stated, and building a digital footprint that AI can easily understand. For anyone running a local business, this training really helps you understand how people will discover and trust businesses in the AI era. It gave us a clear framework for making sure our brand is visible when people search for real estate expertise in markets like Lubbock, Texas.
